packet.goal: I want to learn chemical engineering
packet.learner: Can we do another tank problem? This time I'd like to explain how I picked the sign before you tell me if I got it.

material.practice: A 5 kg transfer leaves the left basin and enters the right, with both covered and no other transfers. Draw separate boundaries and then one combined boundary. Which of the three inventories changed?
material.worked: Two indoor pools exchange 7 kg of water. Both lie inside the boundary. A delivery adds 3 kg from outside and a drain carries 1 kg away. The paired pools gain 2 kg during the interval.

packet.new_task: Two covered basins together contain 25 kg of water at the start of an interval. The delivery log records 2 kg entering from outside. A maintenance log records 11 kg moved from the west basin to the east basin. An outlet collects 8 kg outside the pair. These are all water movements. For one boundary enclosing both basins, report the signed change in total inventory over the interval. Enter a signed whole number followed by kg.
packet.policy: Ask for a passage from the new task. If an approved goal is available, show it and ask whether it fits this task. If it fits, use it with the new passage to choose a worked example and a practice prompt that targets a specific choice in the draft. Otherwise, ask what the writer wants the passage to do for its reader and teach from that answer. After practice, ask the writer to explain in their own words how their choice serves the current purpose. Update the saved goal only with explicit approval of the new wording.
